packaging_checks.details: Portable text is UTF-8 without BOM and LF-only; public manifests use POSIX paths; root and Figure 1 manifests/checksums are regenerated; no GitHub-size file issue is present.

release_validator.details: The validator passes source locks, machine-path and secret scans, 210-cell score coverage, citation coverage/corrections, cohort provenance, BP redistribution scope, Path A, Figure 1, table typography, Table II reconstruction, YACHT helper exclusion, and V8 public-license/readiness guards.

license_scope_checks.details: A root MIT license covers project-authored source/docs/configs/artifacts; pyproject.toml and CITATION.cff declare MIT. Six UCI-derived Iris/Mushroom frozen-BP files remain separately attributed under CC BY 4.0 and are excluded from the MIT scope by NOTICE.md.

third_party_license_checks.details: No third-party author repository, MATLAB binary/P-code/MEX component, or dependency wheel/source is vendored. PyMetis 2025.2.2 is separately installed and its PyPI metadata reports MIT AND Apache-2.0. Upstream author-repository licenses left as NOASSERTION are not guessed because those repositories are not redistributed.

git_normalization_check.details: A fresh Git staging test with core.autocrlf=false showed zero staged-vs-working blob hash differences.

python_import.details: psfce and baseline_adapters remain included in package discovery.

python_tests.details: 16 passed and 1 skipped after the V8 public-release changes. The skip is not counted as a pass.

python_wheel_build.details: A source wheel build completed with the already-installed build backend using --no-build-isolation; package metadata including the root LICENSE was accepted.

citation_metadata_checks.details: Repository bibliography corrections include Derek Greene attribution for the BBC dataset repository, cnab014 as an article number, Jhy1993/HAN repository attribution, UCI Iris year 1936 with 1988 donation note, and UCI Mushroom year 1981 with 1987 donation note.

table_rebuild.details: Path A and Table II rebuild deterministically. Table I and Table II retain explicit 9-pt body/note text; displayed values and counts are unchanged.

figure_rebuild.details: Figure 1 rebuilds from its full-precision CSV on a native 3.39 by 1.82 inch canvas with a configured minimum font size of 9 pt and no manuscript downscaling.

frozen_config_checks.details: Every source lock matches its public frozen file; the provenance copy is identical; the recent-baseline source path uses POSIX separators.

frozen_bp_redistribution.details: Exactly six Iris/Mushroom pools are present and byte-match the formal hashes; y and 20-by-n parts array contracts pass. The remaining 24 pools expose no public path and remain hash-only.

data_provenance_checks.details: All ten tasks have source mappings. Iris and Mushroom use official UCI CC BY 4.0 records; incomplete derived-byte lineage for other tasks remains explicitly disclosed and their exact local pools are not redistributed.

matlab_execution_verified.details: No MATLAB algorithm rerun was performed during packaging. The installed packaging host was identified as R2026a Update 5, but the historical formal-run MATLAB version remains unrecorded.

linux_execution.details: Native Linux algorithm execution is not claimed; POSIX path, LF, checksum, rebuild, Git staging, and Python tests are checked separately.

path_b_public_end_to_end.details: Only Iris/Mushroom BP inputs are public. The other 24 pools, prediction archives, and the YACHT private helper are not redistributed, so a full public ten-dataset rerun is outside the release claim.

skipped_checks: full Python/MATLAB algorithm rerun from raw features
scope_note: Public-release readiness here is a repository packaging and provenance determination for the material actually distributed, not a legal opinion about omitted upstream materials.
